query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email,
       cp.id as client_profile_id,
       cp.interviewStatus, cp.backgroundStatus,
       cp.viaStatus, cp.ipipStatus, cp.sageStatus,
       cp.wowReportStatus, cp.createdAt
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN client_profiles cp ON cp.userId = u.id
WHERE u.name LIKE '%Phipson%' OR u.email LIKE '%phipson%';
